name: steps
title: Steps
summary: A multi-step flow shown as numbered markers: done, current and to do.
description: A multi-step flow shown as numbered markers joined by a rail: done, current, to do. The model is the task rows: the 24px badge column, the completed mark (green, white check), the 1px rail in the line colour, 10.5px/600 step figures. Horizontal (markers in a row of equal columns, each step's text under its marker, a rail between them) or vertical (the rail runs down the marker column, as the task rows' details). Each step may have a panel; Back and Next are real Buttons. Behaviour and ARIA from the Zag steps machine through Ark UI.

anatomy.description: Ark's steps root (data-orientation, --percent): a column, the list then the panels then the controls, 16px apart.
role=tablist (aria-orientation). Horizontal: a row of equal columns. Vertical: a column.

One step (data-complete, data-current, data-incomplete). Horizontal: an equal share of the row; the trigger (marker, then the text under it) and the rail. Vertical: the trigger, the rail under the marker, 20px to the next step.

role=tab, aria-selected and aria-current=step on the current one: the marker and the step's text. Bleeds 6px so the marker lines up with the edge; control radius; hover fills hover (fine pointer), press hover-2 (a row's press), focus ring. linear: not pressable (no hover, no press) and only the current step is in the tab order.
The 24px round marker (aria-hidden). To do: 1px line-strong ring, ink-2 figure. Current: ink fill, on-ink figure. Done: the task rows' mark, green fill and a 13px white check.
The step's figure, 10.5px/600 tabular, as the task rows' step; gives way to the check when done.
The done check (ph check, bold); arrives scaled from 0.5 with its opacity when the step is done, as the task rows' mark.
The title and the description, stacked; horizontal: under the marker, 6px apart; vertical: beside it, its first line sharing the marker's 24px line.
13px/500 on the body leading; vertical: its first line 24px tall (the marker's line): ink-2 to do, ink when current or done. Wraps, never cut. Author text keeps its own direction.

The rail (between this step and the next; none after the last): 1px in the line colour, green once this step is done. Horizontal: from 6px after this marker to 6px before the next one, at the markers' middle. Vertical: down the marker column from 4px under the marker to 4px above the next one.
role=tabpanel labelled by its trigger: the current step's panel (the others hidden), 13px ink-2; focusable (tabindex 0).
What shows in place of the panels once every step is done (Next pressed on the last step).
Back and Next: real Buttons (Back outline, Next primary, size sm), at the end, 8px apart, marked data-steps="prev" / "next"; disabled where there is no step to go to.

items.description: The steps in order: { title, description?, content? } (React: nodes; content is the step's panel).

step.description: The current step, from 0; the number of steps means every step is done. React: step / defaultStep / onStepChange.

linear.description: The steps are taken in order: only Back and Next move; the markers are not pressable.

controls.description: Show the Back and Next buttons under the panels.

completed.description: What shows once every step is done (React: a node).

events.stepChange: (step: number) after a marker, Back or Next is pressed

keyboard: Tab reaches each marker in turn (linear: only the current one), then the current panel, then Back and Next
Enter / Space on a marker makes it the current step (not linear); the change is instant
Back / Next are buttons; a disabled one is skipped
notes: The current marker carries aria-selected=true and aria-current=step; its panel is labelled by it.
A marker's name is its title and description; the figure and the check are hidden from assistive technology.

motion: marker and rail colours over duration.base when a step changes (instant from the keyboard: kbd-instant)

check: scale 0.5 -> 1 with opacity over duration.press easing.out-strong and duration.base when a step is done (as the task rows' mark); the figure fades out under it. Undone (Back, an earlier marker): shorter and simpler, the check fades over duration.fast and its scale resets after the fade
reduced motion: the check does not scale, it fades both ways
trigger hover and press fills over duration.fast (hover gated to a fine pointer)
panels swap at once (no transition between steps' content)
